latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Online Converter (v1.0.0): quickly convert, edit, and export video files on the cloud without needing desktop software.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more, up to 500MB per file.
- Seamless onboarding: automatic anonymous authentication with 100 free credits for new users.
- Clearly mapped API endpoints and error handling for smooth uploads, exports, and session state management.
- Simple prompt-based workflow—describe what you want (e.g., “convert MP4 to MOV”) and get results in seconds.
- Ideal for content creators who need fast, server-side video format conversion and export.
